innovator_vals: This means being a successful, sophisticated, take-charge person with high self-esteem and abundant means, leading change, taking up new ideas and technologies first, and buying to express taste, independence and personality.
thinker_vals: This means being mature, comfortable, reflective and well-educated, valuing order, knowledge and responsibility, keeping informed about world events, researching before deciding, open to new ideas, and buying for durability, function and value.
believer_vals: This means being conservative and conventional, of modest means, with concrete beliefs rooted in family, religion, community and nation, following established routines, and predictably buying familiar products, established brands and American goods.
achiever_vals: This means living a conventional, goal-oriented life committed to career and family, respecting authority and the status quo, preferring stability to risk and self-discovery, and buying prestige brands that signal success.
striver_vals: This means being trendy and fun-loving, concerned with others' approval, measuring success in money one lacks, having a job rather than a career, and buying stylish things that imitate the better-off.
experiencer_vals: This means being young, enthusiastic and impulsive, quick to warm to the new and quick to cool, savoring the offbeat and the risky, and spending freely on fashion, entertainment and looking good.
maker_vals: This means being practical, self-sufficient and of modest means, working with one's hands, with little interest beyond family and practical work, suspicious of new ideas and big institutions, and buying basic goods.
survivor_vals: This means living narrowly on the fewest means, meeting needs rather than wants, often finding change too fast, prizing safety and familiarity, and buying cautiously, loyal to known brands and low prices.
